newsitem.title: ALBANIA: Europe and CIS port conditions - Lloyds.
newsitem.headline: Europe and CIS port conditions - Lloyds.

text.p: Port conditions from Lloyds Shipping Intelligence Service --

ALBANIA, May 13 - Durres - Seven vessels in port operating of which 6 discharging (1 bricks, 1 potatoes, 2 wheat flour, 1 cement, 1 maize), 1 loading phosphates. 3 Vessels in roads awaiting berths, all to discharge, of which 1 bricks, 1 potatoes, 1 cement.

BULGARIA, May 5-11 - Varna - 5-11 Varna east, Varna west, Balchik - 40 Vessels in port operating of which 27 loading (1 glass, 4 soda, 1 tsp, 1 frozen chicken eggs, 2 scrap, 2 kaolin, 1 cellulose, 4 cement, 1 cigarettes, 1 cans, 1 edc, 1 sas, 4 urea, 1 plywood, 1 quartz sand, 1 clinker). 5 Discharging (2 phosphorite, 1 coal, 1 rice/lentils, 1 cars). 2 Discharging loading (1 phosphorite/ntp soda, 1 containers/glass products). 3 Discharging/loading containers, 3 discharging/loading trucks/containers. 14 Vessels waiting in roads of which 2 to load (1 urea, 1 clinker). 1 To discharge rice/lentils, 1 to discharge/load containers/glass products, 10 cargo not nominated.

Bourgas - 21 Vessels in port operating of which 12 loading (2 copper, 1 general cargo, 1 lead/zinc, 1 fertiliser, 6 steel, 1 clinker). 5 Discharging (1 zinc/lead/copper, 1 equipment, 1 coal, 1 iron ore, 1 sugar). 1 Discharging/loading general cargo/metal, 1 after repair. 2 Discharging/loading containers, 7 waiting in roads of which 4 to load (1 tanker, 2 steel, 1 chemicals). 2 Empty vessels, 1 awaiting orders. 14 Vessels due of which 7 to load (1 fertiliser, 1 benzene, 1 baryte concentrates, 1 steel, 1 bentonite, 1 timber, 1 tobacco). 6 To discharge (1 spirit, 1 iron ore, 1 copper concentrate, 1 rails, 2 coal). 1 To discharge/load containers. May 12 - No strikes.

Varna - Varna east - 3 Vessels loading at berth, 4 discharging at berth, 1 waiting at anchorage to load, 2 waiting at anchorage to discharge. Varna west - 5 Vessels loading at berth. Lesport/tanker port - No vessels. Bourgas - Bourgas east - 6 Vessels loading at berth, 3 discharging at berth, 5 waiting at anchorage to load, 4 under repair/dry-docked, 14 due. Bourgas west - 4 Vessels loading at berth, 2 discharging at berth. Tanker port - 1 Vessel loading at berth.

CROATIA, May 12 - Pula - One vessel under repair/dry-docked. Rasa - One vessel loading at berth, 1 discharging at berth. Rijeka - Two vessels discharging at berth, 2 loading at berth. 11 Vessels under repair/dry-docked, 2 anchored, 5 due with delays expected. Zadar - One vessel under repair/dry-docked. Sibenik - One vessel loading at berth. Split - One vessel under repair/dry-docked. Ploce - One vessel discharging at berth. Dubrovnik - Two vessels awaiting orders.

CYPRUS, May 13 - Limassol - Six container vessels discharging/loading at berth, 4 conventional vessels discharging at berth. 16 Vessels due 14/5 (6 containers, 5 conventional vessels, 5 passenger vessels), no delays expected. Larnaca - Four container vessels discharging/loading at berth, 1 conventional vessel discharging at berth. 3 Vessels eta 14/5 (2 containers, 1 conventional vessel), no delays expected.

ESTONIA, May 13 - No strikes. Tallinn - City port - 1 Vessel berthed discharging cocoa beans, 1 liner, 3 vessels due. Kopli - 1 Vessel berthed discharging flour, 5 due. Muuga - 7 Vessels loading at berth (2 petroleum, 2 fuel oil, 1 fertiliser, 1 coal, 1 scrap). 5 Vessels discharging at berth (2 grain, 1 fish, 1 poultry, 1 cocoa beans). 5 Vessels due. Parnu - Six vessels loading at berth (2 peat, 4 timber), 10 due.

ITALY, May 13 - Naples - One tanker etb 13/5. Gaeta - One general cargo vessel etb 13 or 14/5. Salerno - No vessels in roads. Genoa - Commercial port - 2 Vessels in roads, no delays, 33 berthed, 4 dry-docked. Multedo - Oil harbour - Beta pier (loading/discharging of products) will be out of service for maintenance from 2-13/6. One vessel in roads, no delays, 7 berthed. Savona - Three vessels in roads, 5 berthed. Vado Ligure - No vessels in roads, no delays, 3 berthed. La Spezia - No vessels in roads, no delays, 7 berthed, 4 under repair/dry-docked. Leghorn - Three vessels in roads, no delays, 41 berthed. Civitavecchia, Ancona/Falconara, Venice - No delays. Gaeta, Naples, Salerno, Palermo - No vessels in road, no delays. Augusta - Oil harbour - No delays. Syracuse - Oil harbour - No delays. Sarroch - Eight vessels in roads, 3 berthed. Taranto - Three vessels in roads. Ravenna - 10 Vessels in roads. Trieste - Three vessels in roads, some delays at Siot oil terminal.
LITHUANIA, May 12 - Klaipeda - Eight vessels loading (1 pellets, 1 fertiliser, 1 timber, 1 scrap, 4 metal). 3 Discharging fish, 1 vessel in roads, 25 due.
POLAND, May 13 - Szczecin - 44 Vessels loading at berth, 25 discharging at berth, 6 under repair/dry-docked, 71 due.

PORTUGAL, May 12 - Sines - Five vessels in port operating of which 3 discharging (1 crude oil, 1 coal, 1 chemical naphtha). 2 Loading (1 propylene, 1 metallic structures). No vessels waiting, 3 due of which 2 to load (1 propylene, 1 gasoline/gasoil/jet fuel). 1 To discharge coal. Leixoes - The main port unions are due to strike in all ports from 00.01 hrs. May 12 until 24.00 hrs. May 16, but this is not expected to have much effect at Leixoes. Nine vessels operating of which 6 general cargo, 3 containers. No vessels waiting. Vacant places - 7 Piers with cranes, 2 piers without cranes. May 13 - Setubal - 14 Vessels in port of which 4 loading at berth, 5 discharging at berth, 5 under repair/dry-docked. 9 Vessels due of which 5 to discharge, 3 to load, 1 for repair/dry-dock.

ROMANIA, May 14 - Constantza - 24 Vessels operating of which 15 general cargo (14 loading, 1 discharging), 4 bulkers (3 loading, 1 discharging), 3 bagged chemicals, 1 cement (all loading), 1 tanker discharging. 9 Vessels waiting in roads of which 6 general cargo (4 to load, 2 to discharge), 1 bulker, 1 cement vessel (both to load), 1 tanker to discharge. Constantza south (Agigea) - 3 General cargo vessels loading. Mangalia - No vessels operating. Dia - Three livestock carriers loading.

RUSSIA - BALTIC PORTS - May 12 - St. Petersburg - 16 Vessels operating of which 9 loading (2 non-ferrous metals, 1 steel, 4 fertiliser, 1 containers, 1 scrap). 7 Discharging (2 frozen chicken, 2 fruit, 2 general cargo, 1 containers). 5 Vessels waiting, 16 due.

FAR EASTERN ports - May 13 - No delays/strikes/congestion. Vladivostok - 14 Vessels in port of which 5 loading (1 containers, 1 timber, 3 metals). 2 Discharging (1 general cargo, 1 cars), 2 passenger vessels. 5 Vessels waiting. Nakhodka - 12 Vessels in port of which 8 loading (4 metal, 1 general cargo, 3 timber), 4 waiting. Vostochny - Eight vessels in port of which 5 loading (1 timber, 2 coal, 2 metal). 1 Discharging/loading containers, 2 waiting. Posyet - One vessel in port loading timber. Zarubino - No vessels.

NORTHERN BASIN - Murmansk - May 13 - Four vessels operating of which 1 alumina, 1 apatite, 1 coal, 1 cabotage. 4 Vessels waiting to load of which 2 apatite, 2 non-ferrous metals. 12 Vessels due during the week of which 9 loaders (2 steel, 1 coal, 2 cabotage, 3 apatite, 1 iron ore pellets). 3 Dischargers (2 alumina, 1 anode paste).

BLACK SEA - Novorossiysk - May 12 - 16 Vessels in port operating of which 10 loading (1 scrap, 6 steel, 2 aluminium, 1 paper/cellulose). 6 Discharging (1 rice, 5 bulk sugar), 17 Vessels waiting in roads of which 5 to load (1 steel, 1 paper, 2 copper, 1 aluminium). 2 To discharge (5 bulk sugar, 4 rice, 1 maize, 1 copper, 1 citrus). 33 Vessels due of which 24 to load (1 cement, 4 scrap, 10 steel, 1 copper, 1 steel/paper, 3 coal, 2 urea, 2 paper). 9 To discharge (2 sugar, 1 rice, 1 copper concentrates, 2 citrus, 1 tobacco, 2 luggage). Oil terminal - May 13 - 1 Crude oil tanker waiting in roads, 8 tankers due, all to load of which 3 fuel oil, 1 diesel oil, 4 crude oil.

SPAIN, May 12 - Bilbao - 16 Vessels in port operating (2 tankers, 14 dry cargo) of which 5 discharging, 4 loading, 7 loading/discharging, no delays. May 13 - No delays/congestion/strikes. Aviles - Six vessels in port of which 1 loading steel products, 5 discharging (1 magnetite, 1 petcoke, 1 scrap, 1 fertiliser, 1 ammonia). Gijon - Four vessels in port of which 1 discharging fertiliser. 3 Loading (2 cement, 1 steel products). Cadiz - 18 Vessels operating of which 3 ro-ros, 4 semolina, 2 wheat, 1 wood, 1 iron, 7 under repair, no delays.

TURKEY, May 12 - Istanbul - Haydarpasa - 9 Vessels operating of which 4 containers, 4 dry cargo, 1 ro-ro. No berthing delays. Galata - 8 Car/passenger vessels operating, port congested. Ambarli - 14 Vessels operating, no berthing delays. May 13 - Mersin - 15 Vessels in port operating of which 6 loading (3 legumes, 1 cement, 1 rice, 1 livestock). 3 Discharging (1 soya beans, 1 chemicals, 1 bulk rice). 6 Loading/discharging (1 containers, 3 vehicles, 1 containers/general cargo, 1 vehicles/citrus/containers/fabric). 7 Vessels awaiting orders. Free zone piers - 1 Vessel discharging cotton. Seka - One vessel loading paper.

UKRAINE, May 12 - Odessa - 19 Vessels in port operating of which 5 loading (4 metal, 1 oil). 5 Discharging (1 rice, 2 citrus, 1 tea, 1 sugar), 2 passenger vessels. 1 Waiting, 5 under repair, 1 discharging/loading containers. 5 Vessels waiting in roads of which 2 to load (1 metal, 1 oil), 1 to discharge general cargo. 1 Awaiting owner's notification, 1 awaiting cargo documents. 17 Vessels due of which 12 to load (8 metal, fuel oil, 2 oil, 1 urea). 1 To discharge/load containers, 4 passenger vessels. Ilychevsk - Nine vessels in port operating of which 7 loading (6 steel, 1 potash), 2 discharging/loading containers. 2
